provider.description: The OAuth provider used for authentication.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token from the OAuth provider.

access_token.description: The access token from the OAuth provider.

expires_at.description: The timestamp at which the access token expires.

scopes.description: A list of OAuth scopes for which the access token is authorized.

value.description: The OAuth tokens from the identity provider, if applicable.

rationale: The identity-provider OAuth token payload on the authenticate response is a coherent named concept the spec leaves inline; naming it OAuthTokens matches the design-approved exemplar and gives the token fields a single home for sensitive marking.

provenance.observed: The authenticate response's oauth_tokens object is the provider OAuth token payload.
provenance.specd: The payload is a named OAuthTokens component referenced from the response schema.
